payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks if n is even and n/2 is a perfect square, or n divisible by 4 and n/4 is a perfect square, via direct integer arithmetic and sqrt.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a mathematical condition, not any search or backtracking. However, given the candidate families and subtypes, all of which are search or DP, the closest match is forced to be search_backtracking due to the rule top subtype, even though it is not a good fit.
